import os
from pathlib import Path

from cyhole.solana_fm import SolanaFM

def main() -> None:
    api_key = os.environ["SOLANA_FM_API_KEY"]
    client = SolanaFM(api_key=api_key)

    account_hash = "REPLACE_WITH_ACCOUNT_HASH"

    response = client.client.get_account_transfers_csv_export(account_hash)

    output_path = Path("account_transfers_report.csv")
    output_path.write_bytes(response.content)

    print(f"CSV report saved to {output_path.resolve()}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
